stories.title: San Antonio residents can help shape Marbach Road safety improvements at second community workshop
stories.summary: The event, put on by the city's transportation department, will be held from 6 to 8 p.m. on Tuesday, Dec. 8, at the St. Rose of Lima Catholic Church.

stories.title: Convicted Fort Hood shooter files motion for stay of execution
stories.summary: The man convicted in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting has filed a motion for a stay of execution to halt his scheduled death by firing squad.

stories.title: Holy Cross students collect more than 5,000 cans for west-side food pantry ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The food cans support Inner City Development's food pantry in San Antonio, reinforcing charitable community ties.

stories.title: VIA, DoSeum partner to teach children how to navigate San Antonio on public transit
stories.summary: Geared toward children aged five to seven, the sold-out, three-day camp teaches children how to navigate San Antonio’s public transportation system.

stories.title: SAPD: One shot after argument near northwest-side apartment complex
stories.summary: Police think that the victim may have wanted to display a weapon as a way of intimidation, but ended up shooting himself. They are currently stable.

stories.title: For west-side native, designing new tribute to San Antonio's immigrant roots was a personal endeavor as well as a professional one
stories.summary: San Antonio urban designer Xavier Delgado's parents came to the U.S. from Mexico. He's now played a key role in a new project honoring the city's immigrant history.

stories.title: Federal investigation launched over contractor's death at JBSA-Lackland
stories.summary: A contractor died at Kelly Field while helping to move a "static display aircraft" on Nov. 13, according to Joint Base San Antonio officials.

stories.title: San Antonio airport says it has enough staff for Thanksgiving rush as hiring continues
stories.summary: Air traffic control staffing drew national attention Monday when the Federal Aviation Administration briefly held flights bound for Chicago.

stories.title: SAPD: 4 arrested in connection to 2020 robbery, fatal beating of 25-year-old man
stories.summary: Jacinto Martinez, Mark Talamantez, Elijah Rodriguez and Christopher Gonzalez have all been arrested for the murder of Shawn Gaitan.

stories.title: Two seasonal nonstop Caribbean flights announced out of San Antonio International Airport
stories.summary: Starting May 20, 2027, BermudAir will launch nonstop service to Belize City and Grand Cayman.

stories.title: Taco Bell stop turns into vehicle theft and police chase in Pleasanton, dashcam video shows
stories.summary: Police said dispatch received a report that the stolen vehicle had been involved in a crash on West Oaklawn Road, not far from the restaurant.

stories.title: Selena’s brother calls for Corpus Christi memorial upgrades, renaming of Shoreline Boulevard
stories.summary: A.B. Quintanilla III is also advocating for the return of Fiesta de la Flor, a festival honoring the Queen of Tejano in her hometown.
